Hi Samuel / Ava —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really useful call and great context on your latency and data residency constraints. As discussed, the next step that makes sense is a 60–90 minute Private/VPC technical review + ops workshop so our infra folks can walk through a proposed architecture, network requirements, and a plan for onboarding.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Wed 2026-09-08: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-09-09: 11:00–12:30

Suggested agenda (60–90m):
1) Quick 10m recap of goals and constraints (you)
2) 30–45m architecture walkthrough (Redwood infra)
3) 15–20m network / security requirements & KMS/SSO integration discussion
4) 10–15m next steps / timeline / owners

Can you confirm which slot works best and who from your side should be on the call (network/security lead + dev owner recommended)? Also please confirm if you want us to run the call with a Zoom or WebEx (we can send a calendar invite once we lock a time).

I attached our short discovery notes and a pre-call checklist that helps us make the session productive. If you have any mandatory compliance docs (e.g., specific SOC2 sections or contractual requirements) that we should prep, drop those in reply or upload to the Drive link below.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_private-precall
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/HF-2026-017

Thanks — I’ll hold the Wed/Thu windows until I hear back.

— Mina

> Mina —
>
> Appreciate the follow-up and the clear agenda. Thu 2026-09-09 11:00–12:30 PDT works best for our team.

Samuel / Ava —

Thanks for confirming — happy to host the walkthrough. A few pre-call items from a technical standpoint that will make the session effective:

Pre-call asks (network & infra):
- Your VPC CIDR(s) and any secondary ranges you expect us to route to (we need to validate overlap)
- A list of outbound IP ranges you can accept for egress (we have options: NAT or customer egress IP pools)
- Clarify if you require private peering (no internet exposure) vs. NAT with guarded endpoints
- KMS preference (Cloud KMS vs. customer-managed keys; if CMK, we’ll need key policies prior to onboarding)
- SSO: do you use SAML/Okta? We can integrate via SAML or OIDC — service account provisioning details help

I’m attaching a short runbook template (privvpc-runbook-template.docx) we use in these calls — if you can populate the highlighted sections before the meeting (CIDRs, egress rules, KMS preference), we’ll be able to produce a proposed architecture in-session.

Agenda tweak suggestion: leave 20min at the end for an ops/rollout checklist and immediate next steps (owners + dates).

I’ll join the call on 2026-09-09 and jump into the architecture walkthrough.

— Jonas
